commands.title: Convert this .lsx file to .lsf binary format
Convert this .lsf binary format file to .lsx
Unpack this mod into its current folder
Convert all .lsx files to .lsf binary format
Convert all .lsf binary format files to .lsx

bg3-toolkit.doNotPackEditables.description: when packing up your mod, dont include editable files to save space.

bg3-toolkit.conversionExcludeFiles.description: files that the extension will ignore when converting. if you leave the file extension off, all files with that name will be ignored.

bg3-toolkit.conversionExcludePaths.description: if the path includes any of these strings, it will not be included in conversion or packing processes.

bg3-toolkit.conversionNeededDirectories.default: [PAK]_UI, [PAK]_Armor, [PAK]_GeneratedDialogTimelines, Assets, Content, Effects, Flags, LevelMapValues, Localization, MultiEffectInfos, RootTemplates, Timeline, UI
bg3-toolkit.conversionNeededDirectories.description:
list of directories that will have their files converted from editable to ls binary.
!! if you dont know what youre doing probably leave this one as is.

bg3-toolkit.customModPath.description:
this extension looks for your meta.lsx file and then determines your mods root path by moving two directories up from where that file is found.
!! only use this if you have multiple mods in the same folder.

bg3-toolkit.gameDataPath.description: location of your games data folder.

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == .lsf || resourceExtname == .LSF || resourceExtname == .lsb ||  resourceExtname == .LSB || resourceExtname == .lsfx || resourceExtname == .LSFX || resourceExtname == .lsfex || resourceExtname == .LSFEX || resourceExtname == .lsbc || resourceExtname == .LSBC || resourceExtname == .lsbs || resourceExtname == .LSBS
